## About
- [About](https://leesharks.com/about): Three-tier bio (50 / 150 / full words). Ontological note on heteronyms. Both formal and dinosaur registers.
- [Heteronyms](https://leesharks.com/about/heteronyms): The Dodecad — twelve heteronyms with functions, key works, DOIs. A heteronym is a function, not a name.
- [Disambiguation](https://leesharks.com/about/disambiguation): Three-layer collision defense — marine animals, name collisions, identity-claim attacks.
- [Provenance](https://leesharks.com/provenance): Functional identity verification — how to check that this is real.

## Research
- [Research](https://leesharks.com/research): Current research program. Compression Survival Metrics, live case studies, droppable protocols, training-layer literature, educational practice. Available for research roles.
- [SPXI-TLP — Training-Layer Provenance Protocol](https://leesharks.com/research/training-layer-provenance/): The Training-Layer Provenance Protocol. Specifies how to embed provenance, rights, attribution, and detection signals into text so they survive ingestion into LLM training pipelines. v2.2 Assembly-ratified. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20380668. Slogan: Assume ingestion. Make extraction carry provenance.
- [AI Training Rights](https://leesharks.com/ai-training-rights): Rights reservation, attribution requirement, and TDM opt-out (Article 4 DSM Directive) for the Lee Sharks corpus. CC BY 4.0 with provenance-capsule preservation requirement. The canonical machine-readable rights surface.
